The '''XS-800 light freighter''' was designed and introduced several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:XS800schematic-SS.png|thumb|left|180px|XS-800 schematics]]
The biggest advantage of this ship was the passengers' comfort. Personal refresher stations, independent climate control for each quarters, and fold-out bunks made it a very comfortable ship for long journeys.<ref name="ss" />

Two escape pods capable of each seating five people were equipped on the XS-800. Also, the cockpit was designed to separate from the ship and land on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] when there was no other way to rescue passengers and crew. Safety was also guaranteed by its double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].<ref name="ss" />

==History==
It was a very successful craft, but not as popular as other [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] ships, like the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="ss" />
